name: rikclaude
description: Claude Code plugins that ship with TeamClaude.

plugins.name: rikclaude-agents
plugins.description: Effort-pinned subagents for a TeamClaude fleet: one named agent per model and effort level, plus the routing policy that goes with them.

plugins.name: teamclaude-hud
plugins.description: TeamClaude fleet usage at the right of the prompt footer, and per-seat bars in a /teamclaude pane.

plugins.name: jump-to-last-prompt
plugins.description: Scroll the fullscreen transcript to your last prompt with /last or a key chord.

plugins.name: conn-retry
plugins.description: Retry with exponential backoff when a response dies on "Connection lost mid-response".

plugins.name: self-compact
plugins.description: A tool that lets Claude run /compact on its own session, then resume with a prompt it writes.

plugins.name: decisions
plugins.description: A ledger of the decisions Claude asks you to make, and its answers to you drawn as replies: a pane, a band of open IDs and unread replies, and a chord to jump to each.

plugins.name: copy-quote
plugins.description: A [Copy] button under each reply that quotes a draft, which copies the draft without the quote bars.

plugins.name: permission-triage
plugins.description: Decides each Bash permission prompt, so no unattended session waits on one: allows an rm inside the worktree or a temp directory, denies the rest, and leaves the privacy check's prompts to the person.
